items.label: text
items.text: Radiowaveshave the longest wavelengths in the electromagnetic spectrum. They are usedmainlyfor communication.

items.text: Figure 11.3 Radio waves are emitted by a transmitter and detected by an aerial.

items.label: text
items.text: Microwaves are used for communications,radar and cooking foods.Radar usesradiowavesto find thepositionof things.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Figure 11.4 Food cooks quickly in a microwave oven because water molecules in the food absorb the microwaves.

items.label: text
items.text: Foodplaced in a microwave oven cooksmore quickly than ina normaloven. Thisisbecausewatermoleculesin thefoodabsorb themicrowavesand become very hot.The food therefore cooks throughoutrather thanjustfrom the outside.
